# Data & Validation Requirements Checklist: Profile

**Purpose**: Validate that entry R4's field rules, trimming, bounds, empty-value and write-suppression requirements are complete, unambiguous, consistent and objectively verifiable — before tasks are cut against them
**Created**: 2026-08-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Graded against**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [data-model.md](../data-model.md), [research.md](../research.md) and [contracts/](../contracts/).

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the per-field length bounds stated as numbers anywhere a reader of this spec can find them, or only as "that field's bound"? [Traceability, Spec §FR-020, §Edge Cases; data-model.md §3]
- [x] CHK002 Is the unit of length defined — characters, code points, or bytes — given the bound is asserted in two places that could count differently? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-020, data-model.md §4]
- [x] CHK003 Is "trimmed" defined against a stated whitespace set rather than left to the runtime's default? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements defined for a submitted value that is not text at all? [Gap, contracts/update-own-profile.md — the boundary types `value` as unknown]
- [x] CHK005 Are requirements defined for whether a stored bio's line breaks survive to the rendered output? [Gap, Spec §FR-009 — "multi-line" is stated for the input, not the display]
- [x] CHK006 Is a minimum length specified for the two required names beyond "not empty after trimming"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK007 Are requirements defined for interior whitespace inside one name, as distinct from the single space that joins the two? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012, §US5 scenario 4]
- [x] CHK008 Is any Unicode normalization requirement stated for stored values, or is normalization deliberately unspecified? [Gap]

## Requirement Clarity & Measurability

- [x] CHK009 Is "identical to the stored one" defined against the raw submitted value or the trimmed one? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-016 vs contracts/update-own-profile.md steps 4 and 7]
- [x] CHK010 Is the user-visible outcome of an unchanged save specified — silence, or a message of some kind? [Gap, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK011 Can "reject rather than coerce or truncate" be evaluated per field, or does each field need its own statement of what rejection looks like? [Measurability, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK012 Is "no format rule applied" bounded — does it exclude a length rule as well as a shape rule? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK013 Is the object handed to components required by any requirement, or is it a design decision with no requirement behind it? [Traceability, data-model.md §2]
- [x] CHK014 Is "stored as typed" for the avatar reconciled with the requirement that the value be trimmed first? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, §US1 scenario 15]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK015 Do the empty-to-unset rule and the scheme rule state their order of application consistently across every artifact that mentions both? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012a, §FR-011, contracts/update-own-profile.md steps 4-6]
- [x] CHK016 Is the closed set of seven writable fields enumerated identically in every artifact that lists it? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §FR-021, data-model.md §3, contracts/update-own-profile.md]
- [x] CHK017 Do the requirements agree on whether the updated-at column moving is itself observable evidence that a write occurred? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016, §FR-022]
- [x] CHK018 Is each refusal reason the contract enumerates traceable to a requirement that asks for it? [Traceability, contracts/update-own-profile.md *Refusals*]
- [x] CHK019 Do the spec and the data model agree on whether "unset" and "empty string" are two states or one? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012a, data-model.md §3]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK020 Are requirements defined for a value at exactly its bound before trimming but over it after, and for the reverse? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK021 Are clearing a required field and clearing an optional one specified as two distinct outcomes with two distinct rules? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007, §FR-012a]
- [x] CHK022 Are requirements defined for an avatar value that is well-formed and correctly schemed but longer than its bound? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011, §FR-020]
- [x] CHK023 Are requirements defined for a bio containing markup-like characters at the storage layer as well as at the render layer? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK024 Are requirements specified for a save that changes only surrounding whitespace, so the trimmed value is unchanged? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-012, §FR-016]
- [x] CHK025 Are requirements defined for a field submitted with no value at all, as distinct from an empty one? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-012a]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK026 Is the claim that every column already exists stated in a form a reviewer can evaluate without reading the schema? [Traceability, Spec §FR-037, data-model.md]
- [x] CHK027 Is the nullability of the five optional columns recorded as inherited rather than decided by this feature? [Assumption, data-model.md §4]
- [x] CHK028 Are the invariants this feature relies on but does not enforce each attributed to an owning entry? [Completeness, data-model.md §4]
- [x] CHK029 Is the obligation that no later reader must test for two representations of "unset" stated as a requirement on this feature, or as a hoped-for consequence? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012a, data-model.md §3]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items are numbered sequentially within this file; each domain checklist numbers independently
